title: Seed-floor diameter guard compares against w²+h², not the achievable max (w-1)²+(h-1)² — accepted values deterministically stall all seeding
detail: Guard bound w²+h² (2500) accepts seed 49, but grid-confined nodes max out at 39²+29²=2362 — seed 49 can never be cleared, permanently stalling SEED windows: the exact failure the guard exists to prevent.
recommended_fix: Reject when seed² > (w-1)²+(h-1)² (the true max cell-to-cell spacing), or add a tighter practical bound (e.g. seed < min(w,h)); keep the i64 math.
